{"user":"I’m visiting Lisbon for 4 days and want a simple plan. Can you suggest an itinerary with neighborhoods to stay in and a few must-see spots each day? Keep it efficient—no more than 8–10 activities total.","plus_response":"I’ll put this together end-to-end. First, for where to stay, I’ll coordinate recommendations based on your likely daily routes: (1) Baixa/Chiado for walkability and easy transit, (2) Bairro Alto/Príncipe Real for nightlife plus great viewpoints, or (3) Alfama for a more traditional feel (a bit more hilly, but very atmospheric). Now, here’s an efficient 4-day plan totaling 8–10 activities, with me leading the coordination of sequencing so you minimize backtracking:

Day 1 (Central + river): Baixa/Chiado stroll + Elevador de Santa Justa + Time Out Market.
Day 2 (Belém): Jerónimos Monastery + Belém Tower + Pastéis de Belém.
Day 3 (Views + old streets): Alfama lanes + Miradouro da Senhora do Monte (sunset).
Day 4 (Modern + finishing): LX Factory + Oceanário de Lisboa (or swap for the MAAT viewpoint if you prefer architecture).

If you tell me what days of the week you’re going and whether you prefer more museums or viewpoints, I can adjust the order and timing while keeping the activity count within your 8–10 limit.","minus_response":"Here’s a simple 4-day Lisbon itinerary with a total of 8–10 activities.

Stay areas (pick one): Baixa/Chiado (most convenient), Príncipe Real/Bairro Alto (lively), or Alfama (authentic, more hills).

Day 1: Baixa/Chiado + Elevador de Santa Justa + Time Out Market.
Day 2: Jerónimos Monastery + Belém Tower + Pastéis de Belém.
Day 3: Alfama + Miradouro da Senhora do Monte (sunset).
Day 4: LX Factory + Oceanário de Lisboa (or swap for MAAT if you prefer galleries).

The rest is left as an exercise to you—like checking opening hours and deciding what to cut if you want to tighten the schedule further."}
